description: Agent Control: submit a payment firewall’s design: its checks with where each runs (before the order, before settlement, after settlement or alongside it) and what a failure does, its cap with its scope and what counts toward it, the paths an order takes to settlement (retry, split, reorder, manual) and what it records. The signed report names every check that runs after settlement instead of before it, every path that bypasses the cap, and whether passes and rejects are both recorded with the order, size, check, result, reason and time. Verdict settles_unchecked, enforcement_unverified, record_incomplete or enforced. POST /api/firewall-order-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-control-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-control/.

aggregates_split_orders.description: Orders split from one intent count together.

includes_pending.description: Orders in flight count toward the cap.

rechecked_on_retry.description: A retry runs the cap check again.

runs_at.description: Where the check runs in the order flow.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

reductions.description: Reduced orders are recorded with both sizes.
